Faizy Mazhar @faizymaz

Full time Corporate Maz(a)door, part time Chashme Baddoor

Software tester by profession, filmmaker by weekend. I pack a camera, a gimbal and a drone and go looking for frames: Ladakh’s roads, Kashmir’s valleys, Lucknow’s arches, Nepal on a budget, Darjeeling’s hills and the old lanes of Delhi.
